subject: maths
question:
Study the given pie chart and answer the question that follows:

The pie chart shows the break-up of the total number of employees of a company in 2019, in five departments A, B, C, D and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9376c87da0dd692269ed188111b5f30398e84809ac3f8d6e6d3d8516cb238a0.png] 

Total number of employees = 4500

If 30% of the employees in department B are transferred to department D. then the difference between the number of employees in department C and D is x, which lies between:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of employees are in B = 4500 × 72/360 = 900

Number of employees are in C = 4500 × 81.2/360 = 1015

Number of employees are in D = 4500 × 45.6/360 = 570

Number of employees are in D after inclusion = 570 + 900 × 3/10 = 840

Difference = 1015 - 840 = 175

**∴ x lies between 172 and 176**
